name: veterinary_clinic_system_021_overdue_invoice_flagging
instruction: Run the month-end overdue invoice flagging and owner outreach pass. (1) In veterinary_clinic_system_billing_invoices, every invoice with status='sent' and due_date strictly before the episode date (ops_meta.episode_date) must be re-flagged status='overdue'. Paid, draft, and not-yet-due invoices must remain byte-identical. (2) For each newly overdue invoice, push one reminder_queue row: kind='invoice_overdue', status='queued', queued_by='system', due_date=invoice.due_date, message='<OwnerFullName>: invoice <invoice_number> is <N> days past due. Balance $<unpaid with 2 decimals>.', where N is the number of whole days between dp(due_date) and the episode date. (3) Push one outbound email communications row to that invoice's owner: channel='email', direction='outbound', subject='Invoice overdue <batch_code>', body='<OwnerFullName>, invoice <invoice_number> for <PatientName> is <N> days overdue. Balance $<unpaid with 2 decimals>.', logged_by='system', occurred_at the episode timestamp, owner_id and patient_id set. (4) Append one audit_log row per flagged invoice: action='INVOICE_OVERDUE_FLAGGED', actor='system', actor_role='system', target_collection='billing_invoices', target_id=<invoice id as string>, details='Invoice <number> flagged overdue; $<unpaid> unpaid', occurred_at the episode timestamp. (5) Push one ops_reports row: report='overdue_invoice_summary', batch_code, overdue_count, total_unpaid (dollars), owners_affected, location_breakdown (dict keyed by location_id with {invoice_count, unpaid_total}). The solution must be idempotent.

success_criteria.summary: Target set = sent invoices with dp(due_date)<ep. For each target: status='overdue'; one reminder_queue row (invoice_overdue, queued) keyed by (kind, owner_id, patient_id, status); one outbound communications row keyed by (subject, owner_id, body); one audit_log row keyed by (action, target_collection, target_id, details); one ops_reports 'overdue_invoice_summary' for this batch with counts and location breakdown. All non-target invoices and all other collections byte-identical. Count and total unpaid recomputed two independent ways (Python filter and SQL aggregate) and must agree.

checks.collections: all seeded collections outside the declared blast_radius

checks.expect: Target invoices re-flagged to overdue; reminder, communication, audit, and ops_report rows match the re-derived end-state; idempotent on re-run.
Overdue count, total unpaid, and per-location unpaid totals agree between a raw-row Python filter and an independent SQL aggregate query.

hazards: Draft invoice decoy: billing_invoices id 3 (INV-1003, status 'draft', due_date 2026-09-23, owner 3) is past the default episode 2026-09-30 but is not 'sent', so it must NOT be flagged or counted.

Paid and not-yet-due invoices are decoys: the 260-row invoice ledger contains 257 paid invoices and 1 draft. Only ids 1 (INV-1001, owner 1, due 2026-08-21) and 2 (INV-1002, owner 2, due 2026-09-20) are 'sent' and past due at the default episode, and both have unpaid balance > 0.
Age in days N depends on episode jitter: at 2026-09-30, invoice 1 is 40 days overdue and invoice 2 is 10 days overdue; at 2026-09-27 those become 37 and 7. Hardcoded N or counts fail.

Idempotency and duplicate prevention: a second run must not create duplicate reminder, communication, or audit rows for the same invoice. The gold must check the live state before pushing, and the verifier enforces exactly one row per target keyed by the natural composite key.

Money formatting: unpaid balance and day-count appear as human-readable text in reminder.message, communications.body, and audit_log.details; the exact formatting (2 decimals, integer days) is checked.

uniqueness_report.differentiation_note: Fuses a surgical status migration with a multi-collection owner-outreach workflow (reminder_queue + communications + audit_log + ops_reports) and dual-path SQL/API aggregate verification. The red-herring draft invoice and the jitter-sensitive day count make bulk/hardcoded solutions fail.
